CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_source_category_stream(p_source_id smallint, p_category text, p_token uuid, p_success boolean, p_cursor jsonb, p_requests integer, p_candidates integer, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer;
begin
 update app_private.source_category_streams set lease_token=null,lease_until=null,
  baseline_at=case when p_success then coalesce(baseline_at,now()) else baseline_at end,
  last_success_at=case when p_success then now() else last_success_at end,
  cursor=case when p_success then p_cursor else cursor end,
  failures=case when p_success then 0 else failures+1 end,last_error=case when p_success then null else left(p_error,600) end,
  request_count=request_count+greatest(0,p_requests),candidate_count=candidate_count+greatest(0,p_candidates)
 where source_id=p_source_id and category=p_category and lease_token=p_token and lease_until>now();
 get diagnostics n=row_count;return n=1;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_stripe_webhook_event(p_event_id text, p_status text, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_status not in ('processed', 'failed') then
    raise exception 'invalid webhook status';
  end if;

  update public.stripe_webhook_events
  set status = p_status,
      processed_at = case when p_status = 'processed' then now() else processed_at end,
      last_error = case when p_status = 'failed' then left(coalesce(p_error, 'unknown error'), 2000) else null end,
      updated_at = now()
  where event_id = p_event_id;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when secret_name='telegram_bot_token' then (
      select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name='telegram_bot_token_runtime' limit 1
    )
    else (
      select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name=secret_name limit 1
    )

routines.name: ingest_listing_batch
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ingest_listing_batch(p_source_id smallint, p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  result jsonb;
  allowed_keys constant text[] := ARRAY['source_id','source_listing_key','external_id','canonical_url','title','address','district','postal_code','city','warm_rent','cold_rent','additional_costs','operating_costs','heating_costs','deposit','deposit_text','rooms','area_sqm','available_from','property_type','furnished','wbs_required','image_url','cross_source_hash','raw','fresh_delivery_eligible','last_seen_at','is_active'];
BEGIN
  IF p_source_id IS NULL OR p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source and listing array are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(p_rows) > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'listing batch exceeds 100 rows' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('seen',0,'fresh',0,'changed',0,'touched',0);
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(x) <> 'object'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'every listing must be an object' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
    WHERE (x->>'source_id')::smallint IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_id
      OR coalesce(length(btrim(x->>'source_listing_key')),0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500
      OR coalesce(jsonb_typeof(x->'raw'),'null') <> 'object'
      OR (x->>'last_seen_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR (x->>'is_active')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM true
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(x) k WHERE NOT k = ANY(allowed_keys))
  ) OR (
    SELECT count(*) <> count(DISTINCT x->>'source_listing_key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid listing batch, source mismatch or duplicate key' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Serialize batches for the same provider, not the entire ingestion pipeline.
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(913247, p_source_id::integer);
  -- Also coordinate with legacy/direct writers before classifying existing rows.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.listings l
  WHERE l.source_id = p_source_id
    AND l.source_listing_key IN (SELECT x->>'source_listing_key' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x)
  ORDER BY l.id FOR UPDATE;

  WITH input AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.listings, x) AS r,
      pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to((x - 'last_seen_at')::text,'UTF8')) AS fingerprint
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i.r, i.fingerprint, l.id,
      coalesce(l.ingest_fingerprint = i.fingerprint AND l.is_active,false) AS unchanged
    FROM input i LEFT JOIN public.listings l
      ON l.source_id = p_source_id AND l.source_listing_key = (i.r).source_listing_key
  ), touched AS (
    UPDATE public.listings l SET last_seen_at = greatest(l.last_seen_at,(c.r).last_seen_at)
    FROM classified c WHERE c.unchanged AND l.id = c.id
      AND (l.last_seen_at IS NULL OR l.last_seen_at < (c.r).last_seen_at)
    RETURNING l.id
  ), written AS (
    INSERT INTO public.listings AS l (source_id,source_listing_key,external_id,canonical_url,title,address,district,postal_code,city,warm_rent,cold_rent,additional_costs,operating_costs,heating_costs,deposit,deposit_text,rooms,area_sqm,available_from,property_type,furnished,wbs_required,image_url,cross_source_hash,raw,fresh_delivery_eligible,last_seen_at,is_active,ingest_fingerprint)
    SELECT (c.r).source_id,(c.r).source_listing_key,(c.r).external_id,(c.r).canonical_url,(c.r).title,(c.r).address,(c.r).district,(c.r).postal_code,(c.r).city,(c.r).warm_rent,(c.r).cold_rent,(c.r).additional_costs,(c.r).operating_costs,(c.r).heating_costs,(c.r).deposit,(c.r).deposit_text,(c.r).rooms,(c.r).area_sqm,(c.r).available_from,(c.r).property_type,(c.r).furnished,(c.r).wbs_required,(c.r).image_url,(c.r).cross_source_hash,(c.r).raw,(c.r).fresh_delivery_eligible,(c.r).last_seen_at,(c.r).is_active,c.fingerprint
    FROM classified c WHERE NOT c.unchanged
    ON CONFLICT (source_id,source_listing_key) DO UPDATE SET
      external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id,
      canonical_url = EXCLUDED.canonical_url,
      title = EXCLUDED.title,
      address = EXCLUDED.address,
      district = EXCLUDED.district,
      postal_code = EXCLUDED.postal_code,
      city = EXCLUDED.city,
      warm_rent = EXCLUDED.warm_rent,
      cold_rent = EXCLUDED.cold_rent,
      additional_costs = EXCLUDED.additional_costs,
      operating_costs = EXCLUDED.operating_costs,
      heating_costs = EXCLUDED.heating_costs,
      deposit = EXCLUDED.deposit,
      deposit_text = EXCLUDED.deposit_text,
      rooms = EXCLUDED.rooms,
      area_sqm = EXCLUDED.area_sqm,
      available_from = EXCLUDED.available_from,
      property_type = EXCLUDED.property_type,
      furnished = EXCLUDED.furnished,
      wbs_required = EXCLUDED.wbs_required,
      image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url,
      cross_source_hash = EXCLUDED.cross_source_hash,
      raw = EXCLUDED.raw,
      fresh_delivery_eligible = EXCLUDED.fresh_delivery_eligible,
      last_seen_at = greatest(l.last_seen_at,EXCLUDED.last_seen_at),
      is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
      ingest_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.ingest_fingerprint
    RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'seen',(SELECT count(*) FROM input),
    'fresh',(SELECT count(*) FROM written WHERE inserted),
    'changed',(SELECT count(*) FROM written),
    'touched',(SELECT count(*) FROM classified WHERE unchanged)
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_source_id smallint, p_rows jsonb

routines.name: ingest_listing_batch_v2
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ingest_listing_batch_v2(p_source_id smallint, p_rows jsonb, p_touch_unchanged boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  result jsonb;
  allowed_keys constant text[] := array[
    'source_id','source_listing_key','external_id','canonical_url','title','address',
    'district','postal_code','city','warm_rent','cold_rent','additional_costs',
    'operating_costs','heating_costs','deposit','deposit_text','rooms','area_sqm',
    'available_from','property_type','furnished','wbs_required','image_url',
    'cross_source_hash','raw','fresh_delivery_eligible','last_seen_at','is_active'
  ];
begin
  if p_source_id is null or p_rows is null or jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'
     or p_touch_unchanged is null then
    raise exception 'source, listing array and touch mode are required' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(p_rows) > 100 then
    raise exception 'listing batch exceeds 100 rows' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('seen',0,'fresh',0,'changed',0,'touched',0);
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
    where jsonb_typeof(x) <> 'object'
       or (x->>'source_id')::smallint is distinct from p_source_id
       or coalesce(length(btrim(x->>'source_listing_key')),0) not between 1 and 500
       or coalesce(jsonb_typeof(x->'raw'),'null') <> 'object'
       or (x->>'last_seen_at')::timestamptz is null
       or (x->>'is_active')::boolean is distinct from true
       or exists (
         select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(x) k
         where not k = any(allowed_keys)
       )
  ) or (
    select count(*) <> count(distinct x->>'source_listing_key')
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid listing batch, source mismatch or duplicate key' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(913247, p_source_id::integer);

  perform 1
  from public.listings l
  where l.source_id = p_source_id
    and l.source_listing_key in (
      select x->>'source_listing_key' from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
    )
  order by l.id
  for update;

  with input as materialized (
    select
      jsonb_populate_record(null::public.listings, x) as r,
      pg_catalog.sha256(
        pg_catalog.convert_to((x - 'last_seen_at')::text,'UTF8')
      ) as fingerprint
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ),
  classified as materialized (
    select
      i.r,
      i.fingerprint,
      l.id,
      coalesce(l.ingest_fingerprint = i.fingerprint and l.is_active,false) as unchanged
    from input i
    left join public.listings l
      on l.source_id = p_source_id
     and l.source_listing_key = (i.r).source_listing_key
  ),
  touched as (
    update public.listings l
    set last_seen_at = greatest(l.last_seen_at,(c.r).last_seen_at)
    from classified c
    where c.unchanged
      and l.id = c.id
      and (
        p_touch_unchanged
        or l.last_seen_at is null
        or l.last_seen_at < (c.r).last_seen_at - interval '30 minutes'
      )
    returning l.id
  ),
  written as (
    insert into public.listings as l (
      source_id,source_listing_key,external_id,canonical_url,title,address,district,
      postal_code,city,warm_rent,cold_rent,additional_costs,operating_costs,
      heating_costs,deposit,deposit_text,rooms,area_sqm,available_from,property_type,
      furnished,wbs_required,image_url,cross_source_hash,raw,fresh_delivery_eligible,
      last_seen_at,is_active,ingest_fingerprint
    )
    select
      (c.r).source_id,(c.r).source_listing_key,(c.r).external_id,(c.r).canonical_url,
      (c.r).title,(c.r).address,(c.r).district,(c.r).postal_code,(c.r).city,
      (c.r).warm_rent,(c.r).cold_rent,(c.r).additional_costs,(c.r).operating_costs,
      (c.r).heating_costs,(c.r).deposit,(c.r).deposit_text,(c.r).rooms,(c.r).area_sqm,
      (c.r).available_from,(c.r).property_type,(c.r).furnished,(c.r).wbs_required,
      (c.r).image_url,(c.r).cross_source_hash,(c.r).raw,(c.r).fresh_delivery_eligible,
      (c.r).last_seen_at,(c.r).is_active,c.fingerprint
    from classified c
    where not c.unchanged
    on conflict (source_id,source_listing_key) do update set
      external_id = excluded.external_id,
      canonical_url = excluded.canonical_url,
      title = excluded.title,
      address = excluded.address,
      district = excluded.district,
      postal_code = excluded.postal_code,
      city = excluded.city,
      warm_rent = excluded.warm_rent,
      cold_rent = excluded.cold_rent,
      additional_costs = excluded.additional_costs,
      operating_costs = excluded.operating_costs,
      heating_costs = excluded.heating_costs,
      deposit = excluded.deposit,
      deposit_text = excluded.deposit_text,
      rooms = excluded.rooms,
      area_sqm = excluded.area_sqm,
      available_from = excluded.available_from,
      property_type = excluded.property_type,
      furnished = excluded.furnished,
      wbs_required = excluded.wbs_required,
      image_url = excluded.image_url,
      cross_source_hash = excluded.cross_source_hash,
      raw = excluded.raw,
      fresh_delivery_eligible = excluded.fresh_delivery_eligible,
      last_seen_at = greatest(l.last_seen_at,excluded.last_seen_at),
      is_active = excluded.is_active,
      ingest_fingerprint = excluded.ingest_fingerprint
    returning (xmax = 0) as inserted
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'seen',(select count(*) from input),
    'fresh',(select count(*) from written where inserted),
    'changed',(select count(*) from written),
    'touched',(select count(*) from touched)
  )
  into result;

  return result;
end;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_source_id smallint, p_rows jsonb, p_touch_unchanged boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ingest_listing_batch_v3(p_source_id smallint, p_rows jsonb, p_presence_epoch timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  result jsonb;
  allowed_keys constant text[] := array[
    'source_id','source_listing_key','external_id','canonical_url','title','address',
    'district','postal_code','city','warm_rent','cold_rent','additional_costs',
    'operating_costs','heating_costs','deposit','deposit_text','rooms','area_sqm',
    'available_from','property_type','furnished','wbs_required','image_url',
    'cross_source_hash','raw','fresh_delivery_eligible','last_seen_at','is_active'
  ];
begin
  if p_source_id is null or p_rows is null or jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'source and listing array are required' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(p_rows) > 100 then
    raise exception 'listing batch exceeds 100 rows' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('seen',0,'fresh',0,'changed',0,'touched',0);
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
    where jsonb_typeof(x) <> 'object'
       or (x->>'source_id')::smallint is distinct from p_source_id
       or coalesce(length(btrim(x->>'source_listing_key')),0) not between 1 and 500
       or coalesce(jsonb_typeof(x->'raw'),'null') <> 'object'
       or (x->>'last_seen_at')::timestamptz is null
       or (x->>'is_active')::boolean is distinct from true
       or exists (
         select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(x) k
         where not k = any(allowed_keys)
       )
  ) or (
    select count(*) <> count(distinct x->>'source_listing_key')
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid listing batch, source mismatch or duplicate key' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(913247, p_source_id::integer);

  -- Unchanged observations do not take a write-producing row lock.

  with input as materialized (
    select
      jsonb_populate_record(null::public.listings, x) as r,
      pg_catalog.sha256(
        pg_catalog.convert_to((x - 'last_seen_at')::text,'UTF8')
      ) as fingerprint
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ),
  classified as materialized (
    select
      i.r,
      i.fingerprint,
      l.id,
      coalesce(l.ingest_fingerprint = i.fingerprint and l.is_active,false) as unchanged
    from input i
    left join public.listings l
      on l.source_id = p_source_id
     and l.source_listing_key = (i.r).source_listing_key
  ),
  touched as (
    update public.listings l
    set last_seen_at = greatest(l.last_seen_at,(c.r).last_seen_at)
    from classified c
    where c.unchanged
      and l.id = c.id
      and l.is_active = true
      and l.ingest_fingerprint = c.fingerprint
      and (
        (
          p_presence_epoch is not null
          and (l.last_seen_at is null or l.last_seen_at < p_presence_epoch)
        )
        or
        (
          p_presence_epoch is null
          and (
            l.last_seen_at is null
            or l.last_seen_at < (c.r).last_seen_at -
              case when p_source_id in (1,3)
                         and (c.r).fresh_delivery_eligible
                         and l.first_seen_at >= statement_timestamp() - interval '24 hours'
                   then interval '9 minutes'
                   else interval '30 minutes' end
          )
        )
      )
    returning l.id
  ),
  written as (
    insert into public.listings as l (
      source_id,source_listing_key,external_id,canonical_url,title,address,district,
      postal_code,city,warm_rent,cold_rent,additional_costs,operating_costs,
      heating_costs,deposit,deposit_text,rooms,area_sqm,available_from,property_type,
      furnished,wbs_required,image_url,cross_source_hash,raw,fresh_delivery_eligible,
      last_seen_at,is_active,ingest_fingerprint
    )
    select
      (c.r).source_id,(c.r).source_listing_key,(c.r).external_id,(c.r).canonical_url,
      (c.r).title,(c.r).address,(c.r).district,(c.r).postal_code,(c.r).city,
      (c.r).warm_rent,(c.r).cold_rent,(c.r).additional_costs,(c.r).operating_costs,
      (c.r).heating_costs,(c.r).deposit,(c.r).deposit_text,(c.r).rooms,(c.r).area_sqm,
      (c.r).available_from,(c.r).property_type,(c.r).furnished,(c.r).wbs_required,
      (c.r).image_url,(c.r).cross_source_hash,(c.r).raw,(c.r).fresh_delivery_eligible,
      (c.r).last_seen_at,(c.r).is_active,c.fingerprint
    from classified c
    where not c.unchanged
    on conflict (source_id,source_listing_key) do update set
      external_id = excluded.external_id,
      canonical_url = excluded.canonical_url,
      title = excluded.title,
      address = excluded.address,
      district = excluded.district,
      postal_code = excluded.postal_code,
      city = excluded.city,
      warm_rent = excluded.warm_rent,
      cold_rent = excluded.cold_rent,
      additional_costs = excluded.additional_costs,
      operating_costs = excluded.operating_costs,
      heating_costs = excluded.heating_costs,
      deposit = excluded.deposit,
      deposit_text = excluded.deposit_text,
      rooms = excluded.rooms,
      area_sqm = excluded.area_sqm,
      available_from = excluded.available_from,
      property_type = excluded.property_type,
      furnished = excluded.furnished,
      wbs_required = excluded.wbs_required,
      image_url = excluded.image_url,
      cross_source_hash = excluded.cross_source_hash,
      raw = excluded.raw,
      fresh_delivery_eligible = excluded.fresh_delivery_eligible,
      last_seen_at = greatest(l.last_seen_at,excluded.last_seen_at),
      is_active = excluded.is_active,
      ingest_fingerprint = excluded.ingest_fingerprint
    returning (xmax = 0) as inserted
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'seen',(select count(*) from input),
    'fresh',(select count(*) from written where inserted),
    'changed',(select count(*) from written),
    'touched',(select count(*) from touched)
  )
  into result;

  return result;
end;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_source_id smallint, p_rows jsonb, p_presence_epoch timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kleinanzeigen_public_inventory_acceptance()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
with recent as (
  select id, finished_at, fetched_count, inserted_count,
         coalesce((metadata->>'snapshot_valid')::boolean,false) as snapshot_valid,
         coalesce((metadata->>'coverage_ratio')::numeric,0) as coverage_ratio
  from public.crawl_runs
  where source_id=2
    and connector_label='Kleinanzeigen Public HTML Full Inventory'
    and success=true
  order by finished_at desc
  limit 3
), agg as (
  select count(*)::int as runs,
         coalesce(min(fetched_count),0)::int as min_fetched,
         coalesce(min(coverage_ratio),0) as min_coverage,
         coalesce(bool_and(snapshot_valid),false) as all_valid,
         max(finished_at) as last_finished_at
  from recent
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'ready', runs=3 and min_fetched>=3000 and min_coverage>=0.90 and all_valid,
  'runs', runs,
  'min_fetched', min_fetched,
  'min_coverage', min_coverage,
  'all_valid', all_valid,
  'last_finished_at', last_finished_at
) from agg;
$function$

routines.name: materialize_engagement_notifications
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.materialize_engagement_notifications(p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_limit integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_inserted integer := 0;
begin
  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 then
    return 0;
  end if;

  with candidates(user_id, campaign_key, scheduled_at) as (
    select u.id, 'profile_reminder_24h', u.created_at
    from public.bot_users u
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and u.created_at <= p_now - interval '24 hours'
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.search_profiles p
        where p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
      )

    union all

    select u.id, 'profile_reminder_72h', u.created_at + interval '72 hours'
    from public.bot_users u
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and u.created_at <= p_now - interval '72 hours'
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.search_profiles p
        where p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
      )
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.user_engagement_notifications n
        where n.user_id = u.id
          and n.campaign_key = 'profile_reminder_24h'
          and n.status = 'sent'
          and n.sent_at <= p_now - interval '48 hours'
      )

    union all

    select u.id, 'platform_reminder_24h', min(p.created_at) + interval '24 hours'
    from public.bot_users u
    join public.search_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.platform_connections c
        where c.user_id = u.id and c.status = 'connected'
      )
    group by u.id
    having min(p.created_at) <= p_now - interval '24 hours'

    union all

    select u.id, 'autoapply_reminder_3d', max(c.updated_at) + interval '3 days'
    from public.bot_users u
    join public.platform_connections c on c.user_id = u.id and c.status = 'connected'
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and u.auto_apply_enabled = false
      and app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
    group by u.id
    having max(c.updated_at) <= p_now - interval '3 days'

    union all

    select u.id, 'feedback_day7', min(p.created_at) + interval '7 days'
    from public.bot_users u
    join public.search_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
    group by u.id
    having min(p.created_at) <= p_now - interval '7 days'

    union all

    select u.id, 'premium_day14', min(p.created_at) + interval '14 days'
    from public.bot_users u
    join public.search_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and not app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
    group by u.id
    having min(p.created_at) <= p_now - interval '14 days'

    union all

    select u.id, 'premium_day30', min(p.created_at) + interval '30 days'
    from public.bot_users u
    join public.search_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and not app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
    group by u.id
    having min(p.created_at) <= p_now - interval '30 days'

    union all

    select u.id, 'reactivation_day21', greatest(u.created_at, coalesce(u.last_start_at, u.created_at)) + interval '21 days'
    from public.bot_users u
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.search_profiles p
        where p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.bot_events e
        where e.telegram_user_id = u.telegram_user_id
          and e.created_at > p_now - interval '21 days'
      )
      and greatest(u.created_at, coalesce(u.last_start_at, u.created_at)) <= p_now - interval '21 days'

    union all

    select u.id, 'reactivation_monthly_' || to_char(p_now at time zone 'Europe/Berlin', 'YYYYMM'), p_now
    from public.bot_users u
    where u.is_active
      and u.chat_id is not null
      and u.engagement_notifications_enabled
      and u.created_at <= p_now - interval '45 days'
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.search_profiles p
        where p.user_id = u.id and p.is_active
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.bot_events e
        where e.telegram_user_id = u.telegram_user_id
          and e.created_at > p_now - interval '30 days'
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.user_engagement_notifications n
        where n.user_id = u.id
          and n.campaign_key like 'reactivation_%'
          and n.sent_at > p_now - interval '30 days'
      )
  )
  insert into public.user_engagement_notifications(user_id, campaign_key, scheduled_at, available_at)
  select c.user_id, c.campaign_key, c.scheduled_at, greatest(c.scheduled_at, p_now)
  from candidates c
  order by c.scheduled_at
  limit p_limit
  on conflict (user_id, campaign_key) do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;
  return v_inserted;
end
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_now timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_listing_applications(p_listing_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_inserted integer := 0;
begin
  insert into public.applications(user_id,listing_id,source_id)
  select distinct u.id,l.id,l.source_id
  from public.listings l
  join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
  join public.delivery_events d on d.listing_id=l.id
  join public.bot_users u on u.id=d.recipient_user_id
  cross join lateral (
    select app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) as provider
  ) target
  where l.id=p_listing_id
    and target.provider is not null
    and d.event_type='new_listing'
    and d.channel='telegram'
    and d.status in ('pending','processing','sent')
    and coalesce(d.delivery_outcome_unknown,false)=false
    and app_private.delivery_newness_qualified(l.id,statement_timestamp())
    and u.is_active
    and app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
    and app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(u.id)
    and app_private.application_provider_preference_enabled(u.id,target.provider)
    and app_private.application_target_ready(u.id,l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url)
    and app_private.application_listing_auto_apply_allowed(l.title,l.property_type,l.raw)
    and l.is_active
    and coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')<>'rejected'
    and coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false)
    and s.enabled
    and s.runtime_mode='live'
    and s.delivery_mode='live'
  on conflict(user_id,listing_id) do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;
  return v_inserted;
end
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_listing_id uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_connector_lane_result(p_source_id smallint, p_started_at timestamp with time zone, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone, p_success boolean, p_connector_priority smallint, p_connector_label text, p_fetched_count integer, p_inserted_count integer, p_metadata jsonb, p_error text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_source_id is null
     or p_started_at is null
     or p_finished_at is null
     or p_success is null
     or p_connector_priority is null
     or p_connector_label is null
     or p_fetched_count is null or p_fetched_count < 0
     or p_inserted_count is null or p_inserted_count < 0
     or p_metadata is null or jsonb_typeof(p_metadata) <> 'object'
  then
    raise exception 'invalid connector lane result' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  if p_success then
    update public.source_connectors
    set warmed_at=p_finished_at,updated_at=p_finished_at
    where source_id=p_source_id
      and priority=p_connector_priority
      and label=p_connector_label
      and warmed_at is null;
  end if;

  if p_success
     and p_inserted_count = 0
     and exists (
       select 1
       from public.crawl_runs cr
       where cr.source_id = p_source_id
         and cr.success = true
         and cr.connector_priority = p_connector_priority
         and cr.connector_label = p_connector_label
         and cr.finished_at >= p_finished_at - interval '1 hour'
       limit 1
     )
  then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.crawl_runs(
    source_id,started_at,finished_at,success,
    connector_priority,connector_label,fetched_count,inserted_count,
    error_message,metadata
  )
  values(
    p_source_id,p_started_at,p_finished_at,p_success,
    p_connector_priority,p_connector_label,p_fetched_count,p_inserted_count,
    left(p_error,1500),p_metadata
  );
end;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_source_id smallint, p_started_at timestamp with time zone, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone, p_success boolean, p_connector_priority smallint, p_connector_label text, p_fetched_count integer, p_inserted_count integer, p_metadata jsonb, p_error text

routines.name: record_crawl_result
routines.signature: record_crawl_result(smallint,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean,smallint,text,integer,integer,jsonb,text)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_crawl_result(p_source_id smallint, p_started_at timestamp with time zone, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone, p_success boolean, p_connector_priority smallint, p_connector_label text, p_fetched_count integer, p_inserted_count integer, p_metadata jsonb, p_error text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_success is null
     or p_started_at is null
     or p_finished_at is null
     or p_fetched_count is null or p_fetched_count < 0
     or p_inserted_count is null or p_inserted_count < 0
     or p_metadata is null or jsonb_typeof(p_metadata) <> 'object'
  then
    raise exception 'invalid crawl result' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  if p_success then
    update public.sources
    set
      last_success_at = p_finished_at,
      last_error_at = null,
      consecutive_failures = 0,
      baseline_completed_at = coalesce(
        baseline_completed_at,
        case
          when p_metadata->'complete' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
          then p_finished_at
        end
      ),
      coverage_status = case
        when p_source_id = 1 or p_metadata->'complete' = 'false'::jsonb
        then 'partial'
        else 'complete'
      end,
      telemetry_crawls = telemetry_crawls + 1,
      telemetry_errors = telemetry_errors + case when p_success then 0 else 1 end,
      telemetry_candidates = telemetry_candidates + p_fetched_count,
      telemetry_new_rows = telemetry_new_rows + p_inserted_count,
      telemetry_elapsed_ms = telemetry_elapsed_ms + round(greatest(0,extract(epoch from (p_finished_at-p_started_at))*1000))::bigint,
      updated_at = p_finished_at
    where id = p_source_id;
  else
    update public.sources
    set
      last_error_at = p_finished_at,
      consecutive_failures = coalesce(consecutive_failures,0) + 1,
      telemetry_crawls = telemetry_crawls + 1,
      telemetry_errors = telemetry_errors + case when p_success then 0 else 1 end,
      telemetry_candidates = telemetry_candidates + p_fetched_count,
      telemetry_new_rows = telemetry_new_rows + p_inserted_count,
      telemetry_elapsed_ms = telemetry_elapsed_ms + round(greatest(0,extract(epoch from (p_finished_at-p_started_at))*1000))::bigint,
      updated_at = p_finished_at
    where id = p_source_id;
  end if;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'source unavailable' using errcode='23503';
  end if;

  -- Full failure history and every discovery are durable. Routine successful
  -- no-change checks are represented by one heartbeat per source/connector/hour.
  if p_success
     and p_source_id <> 2
     and p_inserted_count = 0
     and exists (
       select 1
       from public.crawl_runs cr
       where cr.source_id = p_source_id
         and cr.success = true
         and cr.connector_priority is not distinct from p_connector_priority
         and cr.connector_label is not distinct from p_connector_label
         and cr.finished_at >= p_finished_at - interval '1 hour'
       limit 1
     )
  then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.crawl_runs(
    source_id,started_at,finished_at,success,
    connector_priority,connector_label,fetched_count,inserted_count,
    metadata,error_message
  )
  values(
    p_source_id,p_started_at,p_finished_at,p_success,
    p_connector_priority,p_connector_label,p_fetched_count,p_inserted_count,
    p_metadata,left(p_error,1500)
  );
end;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_source_id smallint, p_started_at timestamp with time zone, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone, p_success boolean, p_connector_priority smallint, p_connector_label text, p_fetched_count integer, p_inserted_count integer, p_metadata jsonb, p_error text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_application_provider_enabled_shared(p_user uuid, p_provider text, p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_global boolean;
begin
  if p_provider not in ('immoscout','kleinanzeigen','immomio','immowelt') then
    raise exception 'invalid_provider';
  end if;

  select u.auto_apply_enabled
  into v_global
  from public.bot_users u
  where u.id=p_user and u.is_active;

  if not found then raise exception 'participant_unavailable'; end if;
  if p_enabled and not app_private.user_is_premium(p_user) then
    raise exception 'premium_required';
  end if;

  insert into public.application_preferences(
    user_id,enabled,immoscout_enabled,kleinanzeigen_enabled,immomio_enabled,immowelt_enabled
  )
  values(
    p_user,coalesce(v_global,false),
    case when p_provider='immoscout' then p_enabled else coalesce(v_global,false) end,
    case when p_provider='kleinanzeigen' then p_enabled else coalesce(v_global,false) end,
    case when p_provider='immomio' then p_enabled else coalesce(v_global,false) end,
    case when p_provider='immowelt' then p_enabled else false end
  )
  on conflict(user_id) do update set
    immoscout_enabled=case when p_provider='immoscout' then p_enabled else public.application_preferences.immoscout_enabled end,
    kleinanzeigen_enabled=case when p_provider='kleinanzeigen' then p_enabled else public.application_preferences.kleinanzeigen_enabled end,
    immomio_enabled=case when p_provider='immomio' then p_enabled else public.application_preferences.immomio_enabled end,
    immowelt_enabled=case when p_provider='immowelt' then p_enabled else public.application_preferences.immowelt_enabled end,
    updated_at=now();

  if not p_enabled then
    update public.applications a
    set status='failed',
        last_error='provider_paused',
        wait_reason=null,
        lease_until=null
    from public.listings l
    where a.user_id=p_user
      and a.listing_id=l.id
      and a.status='pending'
      and a.submission_started_at is null
      and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url)=p_provider;
  else
    perform app_private.reconcile_recent_user_applications(p_user,p_provider,interval '48 hours',null);
  end if;

  return true;
end
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_user uuid, p_provider text, p_enabled boolean

 SET search_path TO ''
